content: I have sorry-free developments against mathlib for: Temple's inequality for finite-dimensional symmetric operators; Laguerre polynomials with coefficient and moment identities; the digamma partial-fraction expansion and series; and existence of infinitely many zeros of riemannZeta in the critical strip without Hadamard factorization. None appears to be in mathlib. Which of these would be welcome, and in what order should I open PRs? Many thanks, I am also not sure if this is the right place for this question, so feel free to correct me. I am new here!
